# How Can I Keep Contact and Visit Records for Agricultural Suppliers?


You keep records by giving each supplier a profile with contacts, products, and price history, and by logging each visit, quote, and delivery as linked entries, so the farm builds a history of how each supplier performs. On **Jestor** , this runs through a suppliers **table** linked to quotes, visits, and deliveries.


Farms deal with many suppliers of inputs, machinery, and services. When contacts and negotiations live in phones and memory, history is lost, and comparing offers at purchase time becomes guesswork.


## What scattered supplier records cost


- Quotes forgotten or hard to compare
- Contacts lost when a person leaves the farm
- No record of delivery performance or support quality
- Negotiations that start from zero each season
- Representatives visiting without clear follow-up


## How supplier records work


- Each supplier is a **record** with contacts and product lines
- Quotes and prices are stored with dates
- Visits and deliveries are logged with notes
- A comparison view shows prices and reliability


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- Purchases are made with a clear view of options
- Knowledge about suppliers stays with the farm, not with one person
- Negotiations use history as leverage
- This scales from a few suppliers to a large purchasing base


Suppliers in phones and memory Supplier records with history


Lost contacts, weak negotiation Prices, visits, and performance on file


## Frequently Asked Questions


**Can I attach quotes and price lists?** Yes, documents attach to each supplier. More at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Can I rate suppliers after deliveries?** Yes, a rating field can be stored on each delivery.


**Can I see all quotes for the same product?** Yes, a filter shows them side by side.
